key_insight: KV-streams make context compaction in agentic RL much faster by streaming the KV cache forward instead of repeatedly re-prefilling the LLM context.
engineering_relevance: This is a plug-and-play memory-efficiency technique that can scale long-horizon agentic training without increasing GPU memory, while preserving throughput.
method: Attach KV-streams to any existing compaction strategy
Preserve and stream the KV cache across compaction steps instead of flushing it
Use it to support trainable long-context agentic RL with lower wall-clock cost
evidence_signal: Across three compaction strategies, the authors report a 2.6 to 5× wall-clock speedup in training, with no evidence of hurting performance in the abstract.
watch_item: Because the method changes how state is carried across compaction, it may require careful validation that task behavior and training stability remain unchanged in new pipelines.
paper_title: KV-streams for Efficient Compaction in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
